notices.title: Romplur 2.9.9a is available
notices.message:
Romplur 2.9.9a is out for Windows, with GUI Designer and exported plug-in fixes. Romplur 2.9.9 can't install this update automatically, so please download it yourself and run the installer over your current version. Your presets, projects and settings are kept.

Download: https://github.com/plugmakr/Romplur-App-Releases/releases/tag/v2.9.9a
Or from your account at getromplur.com.
